result.topic_en: Calculations on the logarithm of the theta function integrated along period cuts of a Riemann surface (relations among periods $a_{\mu\mu'}$, $\alpha$, $\beta$), log of a theta quotient as an Abelian integral with logarithmic poles, and combinatorial sketches of branch-point/permutation diagrams (12, 23, 31, 123...) with a small table of counts for p.
